description: President Secretariat - Amendment Gazette Extraordinary No. 2153/12 of 10 th December 2019 (Duties and Functions)
categorisation: This gazette contains both specific personnel references (President Gotabaya Rajapaksa) and detailed portfolio responsibilities. It amends the assignment of specific subjects (Immigration, Emigration, Citizenship matters) and related departments/acts from the Minister of Defence to the Minister of Mahaweli, Agriculture, Irrigation and Rural Development. This constitutes both "who" (the President making the changes) and "what" (detailed ministerial responsibilities and specific legislation), making it a Hybrid gazette.
